# opnsense_chrony_settings (Resource)

Chrony NTP server and client with NTS support (**Services ▸ Chrony**, plugin `os-chrony`). This is a singleton: import it with the ID `chrony_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_chrony_settings.this
  id = "chrony_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_chrony_settings" "this" {
  enabled          = true
  nts_client       = true
  peers            = ["time.cloudflare.com", "nts.netnod.se"]
  allowed_networks = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_networks` (Set of String) Networks allowed to use this server for time.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable chrony. Disable the built-in NTP server first, both cannot listen at the same time.
- `fallback_peers` (String) Server used when the peers are unreachable.
- `nts_client` (Boolean) Use Network Time Security (NTS) with the peers.
- `nts_no_cert_check` (Boolean) Do not check the time validity of the NTS server certificates.
- `peers` (Set of String) NTP or NTS servers, e.g. `["time.cloudflare.com"]`.
- `port` (Number) Command port of chronyc. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `chrony_settings`.
